description: This file defines the DesktopManager class, which manages desktop application functionalities such as event handling, component synchronization, backup operations, and web event notifications within a larger application framework.

classes.name: DesktopManager
classes.description: A class extending ApplicationService that manages desktop-specific behaviors, including event handling, component transmission, backup, and web notifications.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up resources, particularly clearing update observers.

methods.name: onAppEvent
methods.description: Handles application events such as data load and data change.

methods.name: saveBackup
methods.description: Triggers a major data change in the device, likely to initiate a backup.

methods.name: getExtServerHost
methods.description: Returns the extensions server host URL after asserting its existence.

methods.name: convertComponentForTransmission
methods.description: Converts a SNComponent into a raw, unencrypted payload suitable for transmission.

methods.name: syncComponentsInstallation
methods.description: Synchronizes component installation by converting components and syncing payloads.

methods.name: registerUpdateObserver
methods.description: Registers a callback to observe component updates, returns a function to unregister.

methods.name: searchText
methods.description: Performs a search with the given text and stores the last searched text.

methods.name: redoSearch
methods.description: Repeats the last search if available.

methods.name: updateAvailable
methods.description: Notifies the web application that a new update is available.

methods.name: windowGainedFocus
methods.description: Notifies the web application that the window gained focus.

methods.name: windowLostFocus
methods.description: Notifies the web application that the window lost focus.

methods.name: onComponentInstallationComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of component installation, updates the component, and notifies observers.

methods.name: requestBackupFile
methods.description: Creates and returns a backup file, encrypted or decrypted based on protection sources.

methods.name: didBeginBackup
methods.description: Notifies that backup download has begun.

methods.name: didFinishBackup
methods.description: Notifies that backup download has finished, indicating success or failure.
